prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: ENV01 foreground, a single original hand-painted transparent game layer on a full LANDSCAPE 1536 by 1024 canvas.
Primary request: Two tiny charming harbor edge vignettes only at the extreme bottom-left and bottom-right corners: rough cream limestone fragments with moss, a few graceful sage-green reeds and small lavender wildflowers. The left and right groups are entirely separate with a huge transparent gap between. Warm storybook gouache, chunky natural shapes, visible paper-brush texture, creamy sunlit highlights, muted turquoise and lavender shadows, matching a cheerful Mediterranean quay.
Composition: All artwork is confined to the outer 14 percent of canvas width at each side AND the bottom 18 percent of canvas height. Keep the central 72 percent completely transparent all the way down to the bottom edge. Upper 82 percent is completely transparent. These are subtle corner accents, not a heavy frame, no large reeds crossing the action space. Preserve the full 1536 by 1024 transparent canvas.
Constraints: Genuine transparent alpha background. No connecting ledge or ground strip between the two corners. No sky, no water, no full landscape, no architecture, no characters, no boats, no ropes, no bollards, no lantern, no gameplay objects. No text, no UI, no watermark.
